units: Ex. R. s. 3 שפחה אחת מ׳ a maid, opp. כושית a negress (slave). In gen. lady.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 16:23">Num. R. s. 16</cite> (not <cite ref="M01057"><he>מטרוניתא</he></cite>); a. e.—Pl. <he>מַטְרוֹנִיּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 3:9:3">Y. Ned. III, end, 38ᵇ</cite> <he>משל לשתי מטרניות וכ׳</he> (not <he>לשני</he>) this is to be compared to two ladies meeting one another (in carriages).
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 19">Ex. R. s. 19</cite> <he>שתי מַטְרוֹנוֹת דומות</he> ed. Wil. (oth. ed. … <he>ניות</he>) two ladies apparently of equal rank.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 317:5">Sifré Deut. 317</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 32:14">Deut. XXXII, 14</cite> ‘with the fat of’ &c.) <he>אלו מ׳ שלהם</he> this alludes to their (the Roman) ladies (living in luxury); a. fr.
